name: Zstandard (zstd)
role: Zstandard defines a lossless compression format and provides a library and command-line tool for working with it.

name: Zstandard for the JVM (zstd-jni)
role: This library exposes Zstandard compression and decompression to programs running on the Java Virtual Machine.

name: Aircompressor
role: Aircompressor provides compression codecs for Java applications.

name: Snappy Java (snappy-java)
role: Snappy Java connects Java programs to the Snappy compression library and packages native binaries.

name: LZ4 Java
role: LZ4 Java provides Java interfaces for LZ4 compression and xxHash checksums.

name: Java GZIP and Deflate
role: The Java standard library provides GZIP streams and classes for deflating and inflating byte streams.

name: PAQ (paq8px)
role: paq8px is an experimental program for lossless file compression.

name: cmix
role: cmix is a lossless compressor designed to favor compressed size over encoding speed.

name: ZPAQ
role: ZPAQ is a command-line archiver that can append changed files to an existing backup.

name: OpenZL
role: OpenZL is a framework for building lossless compressors that use the structure of a data format.

name: JPEG XL (libjxl, cjxl and djxl)
role: The libjxl implementation supplies the cjxl encoder and djxl decoder for JPEG XL images.

name: FSE and Huff0
role: The FiniteStateEntropy project contains implementations of the FSE and Huff0 entropy coders.

name: LZAV
role: LZAV provides an in-memory lossless compressor in a C header.

name: GeCo3
role: GeCo3 is research software for compressing files of DNA sequence data.

name: CRAM
role: CRAM specifies a compact file format for storing sequencing alignment records.

name: SAMtools
role: SAMtools supplies command-line utilities for reading and working with SAM, BAM and CRAM alignment files.

name: HTSlib
role: HTSlib gives C programs a common interface to several sequencing file formats.

name: HTSJDK
role: HTSJDK provides Java interfaces for reading and writing several sequencing data formats.

name: Picard
role: Picard is a collection of Java command-line tools for processing sequencing data files.

name: Slimfastq
role: Slimfastq is a command-line compressor and decompressor for FASTQ files.

name: FQC
role: Dutta and colleagues published FQC as a method for archiving FASTQ data in 2015.

name: LFQC
role: Nicolae, Pathak and Rajasekaran describe LFQC as a lossless compression method for FASTQ files in their 2015 article.

name: DSRC 2
role: DSRC 2 provides software for compressing reads stored in FASTQ files.

name: SPRING
role: SPRING is a compression tool for sequencing data stored in FASTQ files.

name: Fqzcomp
role: Fqzcomp is a command-line program for compressing FASTQ files.

name: Quip
role: Quip compresses sequencing records in FASTQ, SAM and BAM formats.

name: FaStore
role: FaStore is an archival tool for collections of short reads in FASTQ files.

name: MFCompress
role: Pinho and Pratas describe MFCompress as a compression program for FASTA data.

name: JARVIS3
role: JARVIS3 is a research compressor for DNA sequence files.

name: DNAzip
role: Christley and colleagues describe DNAzip as a research method for storing individual genome data in compressed form.

subgroup: The Scala, JVM and JavaScript toolchain
name: Scala 3 compiler
role: The Scala 3 implementation includes the compiler developed under the name Dotty.

subgroup: The Scala, JVM and JavaScript toolchain
name: Scala CLI
role: Scala CLI provides command-line operations to compile, run, test and package Scala projects.

subgroup: The Scala, JVM and JavaScript toolchain
name: sbt
role: sbt manages builds and dependencies for Scala and Java projects.

subgroup: The Scala, JVM and JavaScript toolchain
name: Scala.js
role: Scala.js compiles Scala sources to intermediate files and links them into JavaScript.

subgroup: The Scala, JVM and JavaScript toolchain
name: Google Closure Compiler
role: Closure Compiler checks JavaScript source and transforms it into optimized JavaScript.

name: GHDL
role: GHDL analyzes and simulates designs written in VHDL.

name: Verilator
role: Verilator translates Verilog and SystemVerilog designs into C++ or SystemC models.

name: XLS
role: XLS provides a high-level synthesis toolchain that can generate hardware descriptions from DSLX programs.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: GCC front-end list
role: GCC maintains a list of language front ends included in the main compiler collection.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: GNAT (Ada)
role: GNAT supplies the Ada compiler and tools documented in the GNU Ada development environment.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: GDC (D)
role: GDC is the D language compiler in the GNU Compiler Collection.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: GNU Modula-2 (gm2)
role: GNU Modula-2 provides a Modula-2 compiler as part of GCC.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: ALGOL 68 (ga68)
role: The GCC 16 release notes describe ga68 as an experimental compiler for ALGOL 68.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: gccrs (Rust)
role: The gccrs project develops a Rust compiler front end for GCC.

subgroup: The GNU Compiler Collection and its front ends
name: Front ends maintained outside GCC
role: GCC separately lists independently maintained front ends associated with its compiler infrastructure.

name: DMD
role: DMD is the reference compiler for the D programming language.

name: LDC
role: LDC combines the D language front end with LLVM for code generation.

name: Nim
role: The Nim compiler can translate programs to C, C++ or JavaScript.

name: Crystal
role: Crystal is a statically typed language whose compiler produces native executables.

name: Odin
role: The Odin project maintains a compiler for the Odin programming language.

name: Zig
role: The Zig toolchain supports cross-compilation and includes drivers for compiling C and C++.

name: V
role: The V compiler can translate V programs to C source code.

name: Pony
role: Pony is a statically typed programming language that uses actors for concurrency.

name: Red
role: The Red toolchain includes the Red language and the lower-level Red/System dialect.

name: Seed7
role: Seed7 supplies an interpreter and a compiler that translates programs into C.

name: Mercury
role: Mercury is a statically typed language for logic and functional programming.

name: ATS
role: ATS/Postiats implements the ATS programming language and generates C code.

name: PureScript
role: The PureScript compiler translates programs written in a strongly typed functional language to JavaScript.

name: Koka
role: Koka is a programming language whose type system can express computational effects.

name: Unison
role: Unison identifies code definitions by hashes of their syntax trees.

name: Gleam
role: The Gleam project develops a statically typed language and its compiler.

name: Roc
role: The Roc project develops a compiler for the Roc functional programming language.

name: Futhark
role: Futhark compiles a functional array language into code for parallel computation.

name: ISPC
role: ISPC compiles a C-like language with single-program, multiple-data extensions for parallel execution.

name: Oberon+ toolkit
role: The Oberon+ toolkit includes a compiler and multiple code-generation back ends.

name: Oxford Oberon-2 compiler
role: The Oxford Oberon-2 compiler produces bytecode for its runtime to execute.

name: Gardens Point Component Pascal (GPCP)
role: Gardens Point Component Pascal compiles Component Pascal for the JVM or the .NET runtime.

name: Rakudo
role: Rakudo is a compiler implementation of the Raku programming language.

name: Janet
role: Janet is an embeddable language with a compiler and a bytecode interpreter.

name: F*
role: F* is a proof-oriented programming language that supports checking programs against specifications.

name: Lean 4
role: Lean 4 combines a theorem prover with a functional programming language.

name: Idris 2
role: Idris 2 documents several compiler back ends, including Chez Scheme and JavaScript.

name: Rocq
role: Rocq is an interactive proof assistant for developing and checking formal proofs.
